review_scope: Independent mathematical review of K2 only; no author conversation or other review reports consulted.

comprehension.claim: Finite sequences of bounded perturbations accumulate relative to an immutable anchor: likelihood oscillations add, precision relative bounds multiply, and output differences add.
comprehension.scalar_assumptions: Real measurable negative log densities on a common nonempty support with a common base measure and positive finite normalizers; every successive oscillation is finite.
comprehension.oscillation_check: Fixing any point shows a real function of finite oscillation is bounded above and below. Taking infimum and supremum supplies finite a,b with b-a=osc(d), even without attained extrema. Telescoping gives osc(d)<=sum omega_i.
comprehension.normalization_and_tv_check: With h=exp(-d), E_pi0[h] equals the ratio of normalizers, so the density ratio is h/Z. Since l<=Z<=u, convexity bounds E|h-Z| by 2(u-Z)(Z-l)/(u-l). Dividing by 2Z and using Z+ul/Z>=2sqrt(ul) proves tanh((b-a)/4). The constant case is handled separately.
comprehension.precision_check: Induction in Loewner order gives aP0<=Pm<=bP0. Congruence produces aI<=P0^(-1/2)PmP0^(-1/2)<=bI; inversion and congruence back give b^(-1)P0^(-1)<=Pm^(-1)<=a^(-1)P0^(-1). No commutation assumption is needed.
comprehension.changed_query_check: Apply covariance bounds to the changed row j+d, then triangle and reverse triangle in the P0^(-1) norm. The stated lower bound is valid, though generally weaker than the available absolute-difference bound |sigma-eta|/sqrt(b); this is not a defect.
comprehension.counterexample_and_scope_check: The two successive factors 1.1 yield 1.21, refuting the proposed additive upper factor 1.20. An additive lower factor can be conservative, but that does not rescue the two-sided additive replacement. Point-error telescoping is valid for common outputs in one normed space; internal kernels need amplification accounting. Posterior comparison, local covariance, physical coverage and lifetime risk are correctly separated.

remaining_application_obligations: Establish each per-change likelihood oscillation bound over the declared full support, conditional on the same data and base measure; local or sampled checks alone do not establish the premise.
Establish each SPD relative precision bound in the full common tangent coordinates, accounting for coordinate changes and linearization errors before chaining.
Bound changes to query rows in the anchor covariance norm when queries change.
Retain an immutable anchor and cumulative products/sums without double counting observations or resetting accumulated error through intermediate acceptance.
For sequential internal kernels, derive downstream amplification bounds rather than directly applying common-output telescoping.
Separately establish any claimed physical coverage, lifetime risk, implementation numerical validity or resource guarantees.
